name: skills
description: Build an Open Knowledge Format v0.2 knowledge bundle for a codebase: markdown with YAML frontmatter, plus a language-agnostic gate that fails the build when a document quotes a name the code no longer has, when a link stops resolving, or when a re-read date passes without an independent review. Also review a diff for broken windows: code or comments that a later agent will copy as a reference and so spread bad code.
